newsitem.title: CHINA: Dragonair opens new cargo sales department.
newsitem.headline: Dragonair opens new cargo sales department.

text.p: Hong Kong Dragon Airlines Limited (Dragonair) said its new cargo sales department opens on July 16.
Dragonair said the new department with a staff of 11 replaces Cathay Pacific Airways Limited as general sales agent for Dragonair's cargo services and will be headed by Albert Yau.

From January to May 1997, the Asia-Pacific regional airline carried a total of 15,450 tonnes of cargo which represented 64 per cent revenue growth compared to the same period last year and surpassed the airline's target by 15 per cent.

"In response to great demand for our cargo services, we take another step in our efforts to cater to our customers by expanding operations with an in-house cargo sales department. The new cargo team will provide comprehensive service from sales to booking and freight space control which allows us to satisfy all of our cargo customers' needs," Dragonair's chief executive officer, Stanley Hui, said. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
